subject: maths
question:
Simplify the following expression:

(x + y) (x - y) (x² + y²) (x⁴ + y⁴) (x⁸ + y⁸) (x¹⁶ + y¹⁶)
solution:
Simplify the following expression:

(x + y) × (x - y) × (x² + y²) × (x⁴ + y⁴) × (x⁸ + y⁸) × (x¹⁶ + y¹⁶)

**Solution:**

⇒ (x + y) × (x - y) = x² - y²

⇒ (x² - y²) × (x² + y²) = x⁴ - y⁴

⇒ (x⁴ - y⁴) × (x⁴ + y⁴) = x⁸ - y⁸

⇒ (x⁸ - y⁸) × (x⁸ + y⁸) = x¹⁶ - y¹⁶

⇒ (x¹⁶ - y¹⁶) × (x¹⁶ + y¹⁶) = x³² - y³²

**∴ The simplified expression is x³² - y³².**
